parsed.why: No trans-specific offence; strong equal-treatment law, self-ID and hate-crime support. Deductions: documented airport-screening harassment, sauna guideline excluding trans women, and a legally female prisoner placed in a men's prison.

State-driven universal exposure: passport/visa marker regime with refusal and lifetime-ineligibility threats, entry screening, criminal bathroom-trespass laws, documented custody abuse. Courts and some states partly mitigate, but border exposure reaches all travellers.

No trans-specific statute, no legal recognition; documented police impunity for anti-LGBT killings, gang targeting, birth-sex custody with forced shaving and denied HIV care, hospital care denial. One hate-crime conviction is thin recourse amid entrenched hostility.

Decriminalised, overtly barred entry bans, 2024 harassment act naming gender identity, comparatively high acceptance. Held down by the unrepealed 'homosexual prohibited immigrant' provision and unresolved trans border, detention and screening practice.

Protective statutes (gender-identity discrimination, hate crime) not shown operating: bank-service denial, hate speech unpunished, anti-LGBT arson uninvestigated, 79% social rejection, trans detainee isolated and humiliated by birth sex.
